messages:
Maria (PM): quick sync — need to split post-launch items into 'must-fix' vs 'next-wave' before Friday. customers are pushing feature A and B, but we have a streaming regression. suggestions?
Kevin (Eng): streaming regression looks high impact, repro rate ~12% for long sessions. I think must-fix. :exclamation:
Sophie (Design): feature A is UX polish requested by 3 customers, lower severity but helps adoption. can ship in a follow-on if we don't block GA.
June (Product Analyst): data: NPS feedback mentions streaming 22x, feature A mentioned 4x. Putting numbers into the doc now.
Maria (PM): OK, propose criteria: safety/regression/blocker => hotfix; customer-requested polish with adoption lift => next-wave. Agree?
Arnav (SRE): FYI infra cost for an emergency patch is non-trivial. If we push a quick fix, can we avoid raft restarts? Kevin?
Kevin (Eng): I can push a patch that targets the KV cache edge case. Minimal restart, can canary to 10%.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to prod-10pct at 2026-03-12T15:20Z by Kevin (Eng)
Sophie (Design): If we can canary, we should put UI fallback in place so users don't hit the edge-case flow. small change, low risk.
June (Product Analyst): I'll update the backlog ticket with priority tags and add customer IDs for outreach. query I used:
```
label:postlaunch AND type:bug AND repro:>=10%
```
Maria (PM): Plan: 1) ship streaming hotfix canary today, 2) postpone feature A to next wave, 3) customer comms (June) + rollout doc (Kevin). Who owns release notes?
Kevin (Eng): I'll draft notes and ping legal if needed. ETA EOD.
Maria (PM): thanks — I'll schedule a 15m follow-up after canary completes. :thumbsup:
